name: Small Vessel with Straight Sides and Vertical Flutes
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；11th-early 12th century；Cizhou ware: light gray stoneware with carved vertical flutes under pale whitish gray glaze, the glaze over a coating of white slip applied to the full exterior and the upper portion of the interior.  Probably made at the Cizhou kilns at Cixian, near Handan, Hebei province.
